from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    occupied = {(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] != 0}
    components = []
    unseen = set(occupied)
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        component = {start}
        stack = [start]
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            for nxt in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                if nxt in unseen and grid[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] == grid[r][c]:
                    unseen.remove(nxt)
                    component.add(nxt)
                    stack.append(nxt)
        components.append(component)
    # Pack each rigid object toward the right, starting with the rightmost ones.
    components.sort(key=lambda comp: max(c for r, c in comp), reverse=True)
    final = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    for comp in components:
        color = grid[next(iter(comp))[0]][next(iter(comp))[1]]
        occupied.difference_update(comp)
        while all(c + 1 < cols and (r, c + 1) not in occupied for r, c in comp):
            comp = {(r, c + 1) for r, c in comp}
        occupied.update(comp)
        for r, c in comp:
            final[r][c] = color
    return final
'''
program_path = program_dir / 'task-57d7bde7.py'
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
